_note: describe-alarms on this Floci build returns only AlarmName, AlarmArn, AlarmDescription, ActionsEnabled, StateValue, MetricName, Namespace, Statistic, Period, EvaluationPeriods, Threshold and ComparisonOperator - it silently omits TreatMissingData, DatapointsToAlarm, Unit, Dimensions and Tags from the response, even though put-metric-alarm accepted all of them without error. This is the 'accept but drop' pattern confirmed repeatedly elsewhere in this course (ECR control-plane blindness in Lab 12, CloudFront LambdaFunctionAssociations in Lab 10, etc.), now affecting CloudWatch alarms. These two documents record exactly what was sent in the put-metric-alarm calls, since the API cannot be used to verify it afterwards.

usms-transcript-lag-high.reasoning: TranscriptLagSeconds has no data at 3am and that is normal silence, not a problem - a quiet period should not alarm.

usms-notify-silence.reasoning: For this alarm, the absence IS the problem - the alarm exists to watch for silence, so missing data must breach, the opposite policy from the alarm above.
